[[Category:Token| ]]
[[Category:Machine learning]]
A '''token''' is an elementary unit of data used by a [[machine learning]] model, particularly in [[natural language processing (NLP)]].

== Text token ==

=== Granularities ===

Three primary granularities:

* '''Word tokens''': 1 word = 1 token
** Advantage
*** Intuitive
** Problem
*** Suffers from a large vocabulary
*** Poor handling of words unseen in training data
* '''Character tokens''': 1 character = 1 token
** Advantage
*** Smallest vocabulary
*** Can represent any string
** Problem
*** Loses semantic information
*** Produces long sequences
* '''Subword tokens''': Words are decomposed into smaller, meaningful units (e.g, morphemes or frequent character $n$-grams)
** Balancing between semantic information preservation and vocabulary size
** Dominant approach in modern [[large language model (LLM)]]
